series.name: Gully Cricket Diaries
series.tagline: One gully. Six overs. Infinite drama.
series.concept: A small Indian town where everything revolves around gully cricket. The local ground between two buildings is the battlefield. Characters include Pappu (self-proclaimed captain), Chhotu (twelve-year-old prodigy), Bunty (bookie who bets samosas), Pinky (the only girl who bowls faster than everyone), Guddu bhaiya (umpire nobody trusts), and Bablu (terrace ball retriever). Each episode is one over -- six balls, one drama. Stakes are ego, friendships, crushes, and who pays for chai. Every episode ends mid-conflict.

episodes.title: First Ball, First Fight

slides.text: March heat. The gully between Sharma ji's building and the mosque. Two dustbins as stumps. A tape-ball that's been taped fourteen times. And Pappu standing in the middle like he owns the place. 'Main captain hoon. Like always.' Nobody agreed. Nobody ever does.

Chhotu -- twelve years old, four foot nothing -- walked up to Pappu. 'Toss karke decide karo. Fair and square.' Pappu laughed. 'Toss? Bhai, I've been captain since Class 6.' 'And we've been losing since Class 6,' Chhotu said. The gully went silent.

Bunty pulled out a coin. Not a regular coin. A two-headed coin he uses for 'special occasions.' Everyone knows. Nobody says anything because Bunty also supplies samosas. Pappu called heads. Chhotu called heads. They both looked at Bunty. Bunty smiled.

'Fine,' Bunty said. 'Whoever wins today's match is captain for the season. Loser carries the kit bag for a month.' 'What kit bag?' Chhotu asked. Bunty held up a torn plastic bag with two pads and a broken glove inside. 'This one.' 'That's a shopping bag.' 'It's our kit bag. Show some respect.'

Pappu took strike. Pinky was bowling -- the only one nobody wanted to face. She ran in from behind the parked Activa. The ball pitched short. Pappu swung. Missed. The ball hit the dustbin. 'OUT!' screamed Guddu bhaiya. 'LBW!' 'HOW IS THAT LBW? IT HIT THE DUSTBIN!' 'Dustbin IS the stump.' 'THE DUSTBIN MOVED!'

First ball. First wicket. First fight. Pappu said the dustbin was too far left. Chhotu said the dustbin has been there since 2019. Guddu bhaiya said his decision is final. Pappu asked who made him umpire. Guddu said 'I have a whistle.' The whistle was from a Diwali cracker. The argument is still going.

episodes.synopsis: New season opener. Pappu declares himself captain. Chhotu challenges him. First ball bowled by Pinky hits the dustbin stump. Pappu says it moved. The argument is still going.
episodes.caption: First ball of the season. First fight of the season. Pappu got out on ball one. Or did he? The dustbin moved. The umpire has a Diwali whistle. And nobody's going home until this is settled. Who's right? Comment below.

episodes.title: The Ball Is Mine

slides.text: Chhotu picked up the tape-ball. Held it like a grenade. 'Pappu bhaiya, you're out. Accept it or I'm taking my ball home.' Dead silence. This ball -- taped fourteen times, slightly egg-shaped, with Chhotu's name written in marker -- was the only ball in the gully. Without it, no cricket. Season over.

Bunty stepped in. Professional mediator. 'Okay listen. Pappu, you're not out. Chhotu, he's not in either. We call it a dead ball. Both sides happy.' Pappu: 'Fine.' Chhotu: 'No. He was out. Pinky bowled him.' Pinky, from the side: 'I definitely bowled him.'

Chhotu started walking. Toward the gully exit. Ball in hand. The gully watched in horror. Bablu ran after him. 'Bhai, ruk ja. We'll figure it out.' Chhotu kept walking. 'I figured it out. He's out. If he can't accept it, no cricket.' He was at the gully entrance. One more step and the season dies.

Bablu checked his pocket. Rs 12. A new tape ball costs Rs 30. He looked at Bunty. Bunty had Rs 8 and four samosas. They looked at Guddu bhaiya. Guddu had 'emotional capital only.' The gully couldn't afford a new ball. Chhotu held all the power. He was twelve. He was unstoppable.

Pappu cracked. 'FINE. I'm out. Happy? I'm out on first ball. To a GIRL.' Pinky heard him. Everyone heard him. Pinky picked up the ball from the returned Chhotu. 'What did you say?' Pappu suddenly realized he'd made a much bigger mistake than getting out.

Pinky: 'Next over, I bowl to you. Six balls. If I get you out even once, you call me the best bowler in this gully. Out loud. In front of everyone. And you apologize.' Pappu: 'And if you don't get me out?' 'I won't need six balls,' Pinky said. 'I'll need one.' The gully exploded. TOMORROW. ONE OVER. EVERYTHING ON THE LINE.

episodes.synopsis: Chhotu threatens to take his ball home if Pappu doesn't accept the out. The only ball in the gully. Pappu cracks, says 'to a GIRL,' and Pinky hears. Tomorrow: one over showdown.
episodes.caption: Pappu said 'to a GIRL' out loud. In front of Pinky. Now it's one over tomorrow. Six balls. If Pinky gets him out, he apologizes. She says she'll need one ball. Who wins?

episodes.title: Pinky's Over

slides.text: 4 PM. The gully was packed. People on balconies with chai. Sharma ji had pulled out a plastic chair. Bunty had a full betting operation: 3:1 odds on Pinky. Someone's grandmother was doing live commentary in Bhojpuri.

Ball one: Pinky bowled full. Pappu blocked. Ball two: short. Pappu ducked. Ball three: outside off. Pappu left it. Ball four: yorker. Pappu dug it out. Four balls survived. Pappu was grinning. Pinky was not.

Ball five. Slow ball. A floater. Pappu was already swinging when his brain caught up. Missed by a foot. But the ball missed too. 'WIDE!' Pappu screamed. Guddu shook his head. 'No wides in gully cricket, bachcha.' Five survived.
Last ball. Silent gully. Even grandmother stopped talking. Pinky stood at her mark behind the Activa. She kissed the ball. 'For every girl who ever got told she can't play.'
She ran in. Full sprint. The ball moved three times. Inside, outside, back inside. Pappu's bat was at his hip when the ball hit the dustbin dead center. Clean bowled. The gully lost its mind.

Pappu dropped his bat. 'You're the best bowler in this gully.' Loud. Clear. Pinky smiled. 'I know. Now give me the new ball when it comes. I'm opening the bowling this season.' The gully had its first real star. She needed one ball.

episodes.synopsis: The showdown. Pinky bowls to Pappu. Survives five balls. The sixth: three movements, clean bowled. Pinky is the gully's best bowler. Official.
episodes.caption: Pinky bowled the ball of the season. Three movements. Clean bowled. Pappu said it out loud: best bowler in the gully. She needed exactly one ball.

episodes.title: The Other Gully

slides.text: A kid showed up at the gully entrance. Messenger. 'Raju bhaiya says: one match. Winner gets both grounds for summer. Loser plays on the road.' Playing on the road means autos through your cover drive. Unacceptable.
Raju is Pappu's older brother. Same house. Same dinner table. Different gully. Rooms face opposite sides. Rivals since childhood. Family reunions are tense.

'Their batting is weak but Raju bowls fast. Like actually fast. He practices with a leather ball.' Bunty: 'He has a leather ball?' Silence. A leather ball in gully cricket is like bringing a gun to a knife fight.
Bunty volunteered to spy. Disguise: sister's dupatta, pretending to hang clothes on the terrace. Caught in twelve minutes because he was eating samosas on someone else's terrace.

That night, dinner. 'I'm going to destroy your gully,' Raju said, serving dal. 'Your bowling is trash,' Pappu replied, tearing roti. Mom: 'One more word about cricket at my table and both of you wash dishes for a month.' Under the table, Raju slid a note to Pappu.
The note: 'Shoulder injury. Can't bowl. My team doesn't know. I'm bluffing. Beat me and I'll tell no one. Lose and you deserve it. Good luck, chhote.' Pappu read it twice. Then burned it.

episodes.synopsis: Cricket turf war. The gully behind the temple challenges them. Captain is Pappu's older brother Raju. At dinner, Raju secretly passes Pappu a note: his shoulder is injured, he's bluffing.
episodes.caption: Raju challenged them. Winner gets both grounds. But Pappu got a secret note: shoulder injury, can't bowl. Trap or truth? Family helping or brother playing brother?

episodes.title: Rain Match

slides.text: It rained all morning. In real cricket: delayed. In gully cricket: legendary. The pitch was a puddle-filled disaster zone. Perfect conditions for chaos.
Pinky tested the wet tape-ball. It swung sideways. A LOT. Wet tape made the ball curve like GPS for the stumps. She told Chhotu: 'Tell nobody. This is my weapon.'
Raju's team arrived. Matching wristbands. Raju spinning a leather ball, arm loose. If his shoulder was injured, he hid it perfectly. Was the note real?
Raju bowled fast. No sign of pain. Pappu watched his arm. Nothing. Edged it. Caught. 'Nice try, chhote.' Was the note a lie?
Pinky bowled. First ball: massive inswing. Bowled. Second: outswing. Edged, caught by Chhotu diving into a puddle. Third: the batsman backed away before she released it. Pinky was in their heads.

Tied. Last over. Raju bowling. Pappu sees a tiny wince when Raju raises his arm. The note was real. Shoulder IS injured. Does he exploit it? Does he tell the team? Or protect his brother? Rain keeps falling. Last over begins.

episodes.synopsis: Inter-gully match in the rain. Pinky discovers wet tape-ball swing. Raju bowls through pain. Score tied at last over. Pappu sees the injury wince. Does he exploit it or protect his brother?
episodes.caption: Tied match. Last over. Raju's bowling hurt but hiding it. Pappu knows. Exploit or protect? Family or gully?

episodes.title: Brother vs Brother

slides.text: Pappu walked to the crease. Chhotu: 'Go for the injured shoulder.' Pappu: 'I'll handle it.' Two brothers. Rain. Six balls.
Ball one and two: Pappu played every shot to Raju's strong side. Protecting the shoulder without a word. Raju noticed. Said nothing.
Ball three: Raju tested it. Bowled wider. Pappu still played leg side. Raju knew. His brother was protecting him. Ball four: Raju bowled a half-volley. A gift. Pappu smashed it for four. Even.
Ball five. Full pace. No protection this time. Raju's fastest. Pappu blocked. Hands stinging. Raju's face showed pain but he smiled. 'One more, chhote.'
Last ball. Tied. Pappu hooked it. Over the gully, the Activa, Sharma ji's balcony. Landed on the terrace. SIX? Or OUT? In gully cricket, terrace means out. The oldest debate.
Nobody agrees. Guddu bhaiya's rules don't cover it. Both teams claim victory. But the brothers walked home together. Same house. Shared ground. That was the real result.

episodes.synopsis: Last over. Pappu protects Raju by playing shots to his strong side. Raju figures it out by ball four. Last ball: terrace shot. Out or six? The oldest gully debate. Shared ground.
episodes.caption: Brother bowled through injury. Brother protected him without a word. Last ball: terrace. Out or six? Unresolved. But they walked home together in the rain. Same house. That's family.

episodes.title: Super Over (Gully Edition)

slides.text: Ball stuck in Sharma ji's dish. 'Touch my dish during the match, I'm calling police AND your mothers.' Both threats equal. Bablu climbed. Got the ball. Dish shifted. TV went static. Sharma ji's scream: three floors.
Guddu's Super Over rules (made up now): one over each. Highest wins. Loser carries chappals. Extra: hitting Activa is minus two. Hitting dish again means everyone runs.
Pinky bowled the Super Over. Out, block, four, bowled, block, Activa hit (minus two). Total: 2 runs.

Target: 3. Chhotu batting. Miss, miss, contact -- one run. Slipped in a puddle face first. Still made it. Pappu hit it high toward the dish. Hit the wall one foot below. Sharma ji appeared like a horror movie. Ball bounced back. Two runs in the panic.
Tied again. Both scored 2. Guddu declared: shared ground. Both gullies play together. Nobody happy. Everybody accepted. Raju and Pappu shook hands.
Raju whispered: 'I saw what you did. With the shots. Protecting me.' Pappu: 'I don't know what you're talking about.' Brothers.

episodes.synopsis: Gully Super Over with rules made up on the spot, a ball in a TV dish, and Sharma ji threatening murder. Result: tied again. Ground shared. Sharma ji finds his name on the trophy later.
episodes.caption: Tied on the Super Over. Sharma ji nearly killed everyone. Ground shared. Brothers walked home. 'I saw what you did.' 'Don't know what you mean.' That's family. That's gully.

episodes.title: Bunty's Book

slides.text: Bunty's operation: odds notebook, cash, samosas, homework, gum wrapper IOUs. Premium bet: Sharma ji appearance probability.
Bablu bet his bicycle. Lost. Walked home. Until Deepak -- new kid -- bet something he didn't own. Pinky's sister's phone.
Pinky found Deepak in twelve minutes. Behind the mosque, inside a box. 'I'm not here.' 'I see your shoes.' 'Not mine.' 'Your name's inside them.' 'My mother labels everything.'
Punishment: retrieve phone, apologize, carry Pinky's bag all season. Real punishment: 'Tell everyone you were too scared to bet your own stuff.' Ego left the chat.
New rule: bet only what's yours. Bunty: 'Killing the free market!' Chhotu: 'It's a gully. You sell samosas.' New premium bet: what will Sharma ji throw from his balcony? 3:1 chappal.

episodes.synopsis: Bunty's betting evolves from samosas to real stakes. Deepak bets Pinky's sister's phone without permission. Pinky handles justice. New regulation: bet only what's yours.
episodes.caption: Bunty's empire nearly caused a crisis. Pinky handled justice. New regulation: bet your own stuff. The free market meets street justice.

episodes.title: Bablu on the Terrace

slides.text: Bablu owed samosas, homework, and his bicycle. No skills except one: he was the only person brave enough to face Sharma ji's terrace.
'Rs 5 per retrieval. Or one samosa. Or one homework answer.' 'That's expensive.' 'You go then.' Nobody moved. Monopoly.
First retrieval: commando-crawled past Sharma ji on phone. Ball from behind water tank. 90 seconds. Professional. One samosa earned.
Trip two: Sharma ji doing yoga. Bablu threw a distraction stone. Grabbed ball. Eye contact. 'BABLUUUU!' He jumped to the next building's balcony. Two-building parkour.

Trip three: Sharma ji WAITING with a bat. 'Come, Bablu.' Bablu negotiated: 'Triple rate. Rs 15.' Coordinated heist: Chhotu rang doorbell. Sharma ji went down. Bablu climbed from behind. Got ball. Found hidden sweets. Took one. Professional. Has standards.
Debt cleared in one afternoon. Sharma ji installing a lock on the terrace door. The arms race continues. But the stolen sweet will catch up.

episodes.synopsis: Bablu's retrieval business: Rs 5 per ball from Sharma ji's terrace. Commando crawls, parkour, a coordinated heist. Debt cleared. Sweet stolen. Arms race begins.
episodes.caption: Bablu turned terrace retrieval into a business. Commando crawls, parkour, heists. Debt cleared in one afternoon. Also stole one sweet. Sharma ji is installing a lock. Arms race continues.

episodes.title: Guddu's Moment

slides.text: Sharma ji padlocked the terrace. New rule: terrace = out AND ball gone. Three balls left. Power hitting was a death sentence.
Pappu: liability. Every shot goes high. But Guddu bhaiya had never hit above knee height in his life. Every shot along the ground. Suddenly perfect.
'Bat at 3 today.' 'I haven't batted since 2021.' 'Exactly. You can't hit hard. That's what we need.' 'Nicest way to call me bad.' 'Welcome.'

Twenty minutes of the ugliest, most effective cricket ever. Inside edges finding gaps. Blocks rolling for runs. A mistimed defense that beat two fielders for four. Ball never above ankle. He scored 18. Legend born.
'First samosa earned from batting. Usually I earn them from umpiring wrong decisions for the right people.' 'You take bribes?' 'I prefer consulting fees.' Four years of decisions reconsidered.
They won. That night, Sharma ji's wife called: 'Why is one sweet missing from my terrace box?' Everyone looked at Bablu.

episodes.synopsis: Terrace locked, balls scarce. Power hitting too risky. Guddu's ugly ground-only technique makes him MVP. He scores 18 and confesses to umpiring bribes.
episodes.caption: Guddu scored 18 with the ugliest technique alive. Also confessed to umpiring bribes. And Bablu's sweet theft is catching up. The gully giveth and taketh.

episodes.title: The FIR

slides.text: Sharma ji with a paper. 'FIR for theft. I have CCTV.' He had a Ring doorbell. Nobody knew. Gully went pale.
Pinky examined the FIR. Word document. Google Images logo. 'Thana Number 420.' Not real -- that's the fraud section. Her father's a lawyer. Since always. Nobody asked.
Bablu's mother solved it. Ear grab. March to Sharma ji. Twenty homemade laddoos. 'My useless son. Here's twenty laddoos. He washes your car Sundays for a month.'
Sharma ji ate a laddoo. 'Better than my wife's sweets.' 'Car. Sunday. 8 AM. Next time I call your MOTHER.' Nuclear option. Peace through mithai.
Peace with Sharma ji opens a door: his son Rohit is visiting. Played district cricket. Wants to join the team. Part of the laddoo treaty. One problem: Rohit is terrible now.

episodes.synopsis: Sharma ji's fake police complaint. Gully panic. Pinky exposes it as a Word doc. Resolution: Bablu's mother, an ear grab, and twenty laddoos. Indian diplomacy.
episodes.caption: Fake FIR. Real laddoos. Indian diplomacy works. Sharma ji's car gets washed. His son joins the team. Nobody can say no after the laddoo treaty.

episodes.title: Sharma Ji Ka Beta

slides.text: Rohit arrived in cricket whites. Looked at the tape ball. 'Cute.' Chhotu wanted to speak. Bunty covered his mouth.
Pinky bowled to him. Miss. 'Warming up.' Miss. 'Adjusting.' Bowled. 'Dustbin moved.' It didn't. District cricket was Under-15. Three years ago.
'He's terrible.' 'His father has the terrace key.' 'We play a bad batsman for terrace access?' 'Welcome to Indian politics.'
Rohit tried a helicopter shot to a good length ball. Bat flew into Activa's mirror. Minus two AND repair bill. But then: pull shot. His one real shot. Four. Again: four. One shot still works.
Won. Rohit scored 12. All pulls. Sharma ji beaming from balcony. Threw the terrace key down. 'Good match, beta! DON'T touch my dish.' The gully cheered.

episodes.synopsis: Rohit in cricket whites at dustbin stumps. Terrible but thinks he's Kohli. One shot works: the pull. 12 runs. All pulls. Gets them the terrace key. Worst-best player.
episodes.caption: Rohit plays district cricket in his head. Helicopter shots hitting mirrors. But his pull works. 12 runs. Terrace key earned. Worst-best player. Politics wins championships.

episodes.title: Commentary Box

slides.text: Bablu on terrace. Bluetooth speaker. Three packages: Hindi free, English Rs 2 (bad English), Bhojpuri Rs 5 (grandmother on video call). 'Welcome to GCBN.'
'Pappu is come to the crease. His bat is belonging to his cousin. The bowler is bowling very dangerly. The ball is somewhere. I am confused.'
Grandmother's Bhojpuri: incredible. 'MAAR SAALA MAAR! CHHOTU TU TOH CHAMPION NIKLA!' Most passionate commentary in history. Subscribers: 0 to 11 in one over.
Guddu demanded a spot. Analytical vs emotional. They contradicted each other. 'Bad shot.' 'SHOT OF THE SEASON!' Speaker fell off the terrace. Pinky caught it. 'Stop or I bowl this into the dish.'
Three-person team: entertainment, analysis, Bhojpuri hype. Bunty selling ads. First ad: 'Bunty's Samosas: Fueling Champions Since 2019. Not responsible for stomach issues.'

episodes.synopsis: GCBN is born. Bablu's commentary, Guddu's analysis, grandmother's Bhojpuri hype. Bunty sells ad spots. The gully gets its own broadcasting network.
episodes.caption: GCBN is born. Three languages. Grandmother is the star. Bunty selling samosa ads. The gully has its own broadcasting network. Empires start from one terrace.

episodes.title: Famous

slides.text: Grandmother's commentary: 50K views. 'Better than Aakash Chopra.' 'Give her a contract.' More famous than any player.
Local news: 'India's cutest gully cricket.' Chhotu: 'Don't call us cute. We're ATHLETES.' In chappals. With tape ball.
Everyone performed. Pappu: fake practice shots. Rohit: whites again. Bunty: sponsor booth. Match for camera: 4 runs in 3 overs. All extras. Everyone showing off instead of playing.
Reporter about to leave. Grandmother's commentary started. 'THAT's the story.' 2 million YouTube views. Grandmother offered IPL guest spot. Declined. 'IPL doesn't play tape ball. Waste of time.'

episodes.synopsis: Viral grandmother. News channel visit. Everyone performs badly for camera. Grandmother saves it. 2M views. IPL offers her a spot. She declines: 'They don't play tape ball.'
episodes.caption: Went viral. Not for cricket. For grandmother. IPL offered her a spot. 'They don't play tape ball. Waste of time.' Still can't afford a new ball.

episodes.title: The Sponsor

slides.text: Mr. Agarwal: 'Free tape balls. Unlimited. Pads. Bat. Just a banner and commentary mention.' UNLIMITED BALLS. The gully stopped breathing.

Pappu against. Pinky against (banner is ugly). Everyone else: UNLIMITED BALLS. 9-2. Deal accepted. Banner went up. Neon orange. Then the equipment arrived. 20 balls. Pappu held a perfect round ball. 'Fine. Banner stays.'

Grandmother's commentary now: 'AGARWAL SPORTS SE AAYA HAI YEH BAT! AGARWAL SPORTS KA BALL!' Every sentence mentions the sponsor. Agarwal watching from his shop, wiping a tear. Best investment of his life.

episodes.synopsis: Agarwal Sports offers unlimited balls for a banner. Pappu says selling out. Bunty says survival. Vote: 9-2 for the deal. Grandmother becomes the best brand ambassador ever.
episodes.caption: The gully sold out. Kind of. Neon banner. But unlimited balls. Grandmother is the world's best brand ambassador. Sometimes selling out is growing up. With uglier walls.

episodes.title: The Tournament

slides.text: 47 players. Bunty: 'Tournament. Eight teams. Entry Rs 10. Winner gets trophy.' 'What trophy?' 'Working on it.'
Bournvita cup spray-painted gold, on broken phone stand. 'GULLY CRICKET CHAMPIONS' in Sharpie. Rs 15. The most beautiful trophy ever. 'Show some respect.'
Highlights: plumber's son bowls with wet hands. Bablu's team: 3 runs. Pinky: all 6 wickets. Bunty's team won via samosa bribery.
Pinky vs Bunty. He tried samosa bribe. They ate the samosas AND won. 'Not fair!' 'You didn't say we couldn't eat AND play.' Out-strategized by his own samosas.
Final: Pinky's Ballers vs Pappu's OG. Full neighborhood. Bournvita cup on a stool. 'Not again,' Pappu said.

episodes.synopsis: 47 players, space for 12. Eight-team tournament. Bournvita cup trophy. Samosa bribery backfires. Final: Pinky vs Pappu again.
episodes.caption: Three days. Eight teams. Gold Bournvita cup. Samosa bribery backfired deliciously. Final: Pinky vs Pappu. Again. The trophy means the world.

episodes.title: The Final

slides.text: Three needed. Last over. Pinky bowling. Pappu batting. Grandmother giving episode callbacks. The content is deep.
Dot. Single. Block. Run out. Two for 3 needed. Two balls left.
Pappu swept. Practiced every night. Ball raced to wall. No boundaries in gully cricket. One run. One needed.
Pinky's change-up. Pappu hit through it. Too hard. Ball sailed toward the terrace.
Sharma ji on the terrace. Put down his chai. One step left. Caught it. ONE-HANDED. Chai in the other hand. The gully lost its entire mind.
No rule for terrace catch. Sharma ji holding ball aloft. Both teams claiming victory. Grandmother: 'MUJHE NAHIN PATA! BHAGWAN JAANE!' Result: PENDING.

episodes.synopsis: Sharma ji catches a terrace shot one-handed while holding chai. The greatest catch in gully history. No rule exists for it. Trophy unclaimed. Result: PENDING.
episodes.caption: Sharma ji caught it one-handed. Holding chai. No rule exists. Trophy unclaimed. Grandmother doesn't know. God knows. Comment: OUT or NOT OUT?

episodes.title: The Verdict

slides.text: Advocate Mishra. Plastic chair court. Bunty as bailiff with whistle. Sharma ji in wedding kurta. More important than weddings.
Pappu: 'Ball crossed building. Six. Spectator catch doesn't count.' Chhotu: 'Terrace IS the field. Every retrieved ball was in play. Caught on field. OUT.' Both strong.
'I caught it to save my chai. Cricket was accidental.' 'Chai defense?' 'My chai costs Rs 15. The ball costs Rs 30. Wait--' Logic crumbling.
Verdict: catch valid but bonus run for extraordinary dismissal. TIE. Trophy shared. Shared schedule. Sunday on Sharma ji's TV. He said he doesn't want it. Two days later: next to his wedding photo.

episodes.synopsis: Lawyer father settles the catch. Sharma ji testifies about 'chai defense.' Verdict: tie, trophy shared. Sharma ji displays it next to his wedding photo.
episodes.caption: Gully cricket's first legal proceeding. Chai defense testimony. Verdict: tie. Trophy shared. Sharma ji doesn't want the cup. It's next to his wedding photo now.

episodes.title: Broken Trophy

slides.text: Bablu polished too hard. Cup cracked. Three pieces. Gold paint revealed Bournvita logo. 'NOOO!' Crime scene faces.
Each person contributes one thing. Even Sharma ji, who 'doesn't care,' donated a brass plate. His wife wrote 'CHAMPIONS' on it. She was a fan.
Worse paint. Crooked base. Everyone's literal fingerprints in wet paint. Perfect. Stays at the gully permanently. Sharma ji found 'TERRACE CATCH' next to his name. He smiled.

episodes.synopsis: Bablu breaks the cup. Gully mourns. Rebuilds together. Everyone's fingerprints in wet paint. Worse but more meaningful. Sharma ji's name: 'Terrace Catch.'
episodes.caption: Trophy broke. Rebuilt together. Worse paint, fingerprints in it, everyone's name engraved. Sharma ji: 'Terrace Catch.' He smiled. First time anyone saw that.

episodes.title: The Wall of Records

slides.text: Bablu writing records on wall. Data: commentary recordings buried under Bhojpuri and his terrible memory.
Everyone remembered bigger. Except Chhotu. 'I have a spreadsheet.' He was twelve. Most runs: Pappu 187. Best bowling: Pinky 34 wickets. Most Activa hits: Bablu 11.

Not just stats. Stories. 'Pinky's First Ball.' 'Brother vs Brother.' Sharma ji's wife: 'The day I started watching and couldn't stop.' Grandmother: 'I found my calling.' A 4-year-old's drawing: two stick figures and a circle. Best thing on the wall.

episodes.synopsis: Stats wall. Disputes settled by Chhotu's spreadsheet. Stories added by everyone. Sharma ji's wife writes on the wall. A 4-year-old's drawing is the best thing on it.
episodes.caption: The wall has stats corrected by a 12-year-old's spreadsheet. Stories from everyone. And a 4-year-old's cricket drawing. Two stick figures and a circle. That's all cricket needs to be.

episodes.title: Awards Night

slides.text: String lights. Bunty as MC in tie over t-shirt. Nine categories. Trophies from bottle caps and cardboard. One real Rs 50 trophy.
Best Bat: Pappu. Best Bowl: Pinky. Most Creative Excuse: Guddu ('The dustbin was breathing'). Best Business: Bunty (gave it to himself). Most Improved From Hated to Tolerated: Rohit.

Lifetime Achievement. 'Screamed at us. Locked the terrace. Became one of us.' Sharma ji came down in wedding kurta. 'Ugliest thing. Also the nicest. Can't imagine this gully without you.' Wife from window: 'I HEARD EVERYTHING!'

Group photo. Everyone. Sharma ji center (pretending he doesn't want to be). Grandmother on phone held up. Samosas visible. The ugliest, most beautiful photo of the most unimportant, most important cricket league.

episodes.synopsis: First Annual Gully Cricket Awards. Cardboard trophies. Best Fight, Best Fake Injury. Sharma ji's Lifetime Achievement: 'Ugliest thing. Also the nicest.' Group photo.
episodes.caption: First Annual Gully Cricket Awards. Sharma ji's Lifetime Achievement: 'Ugliest thing. Also the nicest.' His wife heard everything. The group photo has everyone. This is what cricket is actually about.

episodes.title: The Scout

slides.text: Coach Rekha from City Cricket Academy. 'I want to trial the bowler and the spreadsheet kid.' Real trials. The gully went proud quiet.
Rohit offered to drive Chhotu. 'Someone should have done it for me.' Quietly. The gully heard. Felt it. Said nothing.
6 AM. Whole gully showed up. Pappu: 'Don't embarrass us.' Bunty: samosas. Guddu: 'Straight bat.' Bablu: 'Don't climb anything.' Sharma ji from balcony: 'Win.' Then went inside.

episodes.synopsis: Academy trials for Pinky and Chhotu. Rohit offers to drive: 'Someone should have done it for me.' Whole gully shows up at 6 AM. Sharma ji: 'Win.'
episodes.caption: Real academy scouted Pinky and Chhotu. Rohit's driving. 'Someone should have done it for me.' Sharma ji said one word: 'Win.' That's everything.

episodes.title: While They're Gone

slides.text: 'Who's bowling?' Silence. 'Pinky always opened.' 'Who's keeping score?' 'Chhotu had the spreadsheet.' Gone for a day. Felt like a missing tooth.
Guddu: 'Not everyone leaves. That's not failing. Some stories are about making where you are better.' Nobody expected philosophy from Guddu.
'Pinky got selected. Under-16.' Eruption. 'I didn't make it. Come back in two years.' Silence. Then Pappu: 'We'll make them beg you.'
8 PM. Pinky stepped out. Cheers. Chhotu stepped out. LOUDER cheers. For the one who didn't make it. He cried. Not because he failed. Because they cheered. That's the gully.

episodes.synopsis: Gully without Pinky and Chhotu. The gap felt. Guddu's philosophy about staying. Pinky selected. Chhotu told to come back in two years. Gully cheers louder for the one who didn't make it.
episodes.caption: Pinky made it. Chhotu didn't. The gully cheered louder for the one who didn't. Gully cricket isn't about who leaves. It's about who's there when you come back.

episodes.title: Remember the Tape Ball

slides.text: Perfect line. Perfect length. Pappu out clean. Nobody excited. Technically perfect. Completely lifeless.
'YEH WOH PINKY NAHIN HAI. WOH FIRE KAHAN GAYI? CRICKET MEIN MARKS NAHIN MILTE.' The whole gully heard. Including Pinky.

Chhotu held out the old tape ball. Taped fourteen times. Her name faded. 'Remember what it feels like.' She kissed it. 'For every girl.' Ran in wild. Around the Activa. The ball moved angry, beautiful, impossible. Pappu just watched. 'THERE she is,' grandmother screamed.
'Weekends in the gully. Non-negotiable.' 'Saturday practice, Sunday gully.' Textbook six days. Thunderstorm on the seventh.

episodes.synopsis: Academy Pinky bowls technically perfect but lifeless. Grandmother notices first. Chhotu hands her the old tape ball. She remembers. Negotiates: textbook six days, thunderstorm on the seventh.
episodes.caption: Academy made her perfect. Gully made her dangerous. She doesn't have to choose. Textbook six days, thunderstorm on the seventh. The best Pinky is both.

episodes.title: Same Time Next Year

slides.text: Sunday afternoon. March heat. Full gully. One team now. Sharma ji on terrace. Grandmother on speaker. Samosas flowing. Nothing special. Everything special.
Pinky bowling tape ball. Pappu in chappals. Chhotu scoring. Guddu umpiring honestly. Everyone in their place.
Last ball. Pappu hit it to the terrace. Sharma ji put down chai. Stepped left. Caught it. Again. Same catch. Same man. Same chai. The gully erupted.
'CHHOTU! DINNER!' The universal match-ender. 'One more over!' 'NOW!' When Ma calls, you go.
Gully emptying. Bat in bag. Dustbin stumps left (always there). 'Same time next year?' 'Same time always.'

The gully at dusk. Empty. Dustbin stumps. Faded banner. Wall of records. Trophy on shelf. Sharma ji's chair on terrace. Just a gap between two buildings. But between March and dinner time, it's a stadium. A home. A family. See you next summer.

episodes.synopsis: A regular Sunday. Nothing dramatic. Everyone plays. Sharma ji catches it again. Mother calls Chhotu home for dinner. The gully empties. Dustbin stumps wait. See you next summer.
episodes.caption: Not every story ends with a trophy. Some end with a mother calling you home. The gully is empty now. Dustbin stumps waiting. It's just a gap between buildings. Until next March. Same time. Same gully. See you next summer.
